instruction: Help me use the Calculator to calculate the result of the following question: Car A and B travel in the same direction. Car A travels at a speed of 60 km/h. Car B travels at a speed of 80 km/h, but is 20 km behind Car A. How many hours will it take for Car B to catch up with Car A?
evaluator: defaults read com.apple.calculator LastResultValue 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.6f\n", $1}' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "1.000000" && echo "True" || echo "False"
